anomalies.description: The woman initiates an attack on the man who is lying prone on a table; he appears initially helpless and unable to defend himself as she strikes or grabs him.
A sustained physical fight between a man in a dark suit and a woman in an ornate black-and-gold outfit, involving grappling, throws, and close-quarters combat within a richly decorated room.
After being thrown, the woman lies on the floor while the man stands over her and delivers repeated strikes; she is visibly incapacitated and unable to effectively resist during this phase.

A man in a dark suit engages in intense hand-to-hand combat with an opponent wearing ornate black-and-gold attire, involving throws, grapples, and weapon use (a knife or blade) in a richly decorated room.
After being subdued, the opponent is held in a vulnerable position while the attacker appears to threaten or strike them with a blade; the victim shows no active resistance, suggesting helplessness.
Two individuals engage in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat: one in dark suit attacks, the other in ornate dress defends and counters, involving strikes, blocks, and a table being shattered.

After being thrown onto a chaise lounge and knocked unconscious (f6–f7), the man in the suit is repeatedly struck while helpless on the floor and furniture by the woman in the ornate dress (f10–f15), constituting abuse of a defenseless victim.

A woman and a man engage in a physical fight involving rapid strikes, dodging, and defensive maneuvers in an ornate room; the woman initiates with a low strike (f3), the man reacts and attempts to block/evade (f4–f6, f11–f12), and both display combat stances and impacts (f7, f10, f14–f15).

A man is violently struck by a blade protruding from a door handle, causing him to recoil and fall backward in pain; a woman is seen wielding a fan-like weapon in the same sequence, indicating mutual combat.
The man is shown mid-air, having been thrown or propelled backward against the door, then lands on the floor in a split position—consistent with being forcefully repelled during a fight.
The woman reacts with shock and distress after the confrontation, holding a fan defensively and turning away—suggesting the immediate aftermath of physical combat.
A man in a red jacket is seen grabbing and physically engaging another person in a close-quarters struggle near a doorway.

The same two individuals (man in red jacket and another person) are shown in a continued physical confrontation, with the man in red holding the other person tightly while both display alarmed expressions.
A rapid motion blur shows one individual (likely Jackie Chan) swinging or being swung in a violent physical exchange, consistent with an ongoing fight sequence.

After being thrown, the woman lies on the floor while the man stands over her and delivers repeated strikes; she is visibly incapacitated and unable to effectively resist during this phase.

A man in a dark suit engages in intense hand-to-hand combat with an opponent wearing ornate black-and-gold attire, involving throws, grapples, and weapon use (a knife or blade) in a richly decorated room.
After being subdued, the opponent is held in a vulnerable position while the attacker appears to threaten or strike them with a blade; the victim shows no active resistance, suggesting helplessness.
Two individuals engage in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat: one in dark suit attacks, the other in ornate dress defends and counters, involving strikes, blocks, and a table being shattered.

After being thrown onto a chaise lounge and knocked unconscious (f6–f7), the man in the suit is repeatedly struck while helpless on the floor and furniture by the woman in the ornate dress (f10–f15), constituting abuse of a defenseless victim.

A woman and a man engage in a physical fight involving rapid strikes, dodging, and defensive maneuvers in an ornate room; the woman initiates with a low strike (f3), the man reacts and attempts to block/evade (f4–f6, f11–f12), and both display combat stances and impacts (f7, f10, f14–f15).

A man is violently struck by a blade protruding from a door handle, causing him to recoil and fall backward in pain; a woman is seen wielding a fan-like weapon in the same sequence, indicating mutual combat.
The man is shown mid-air, having been thrown or propelled backward against the door, then lands on the floor in a split position—consistent with being forcefully repelled during a fight.
The woman reacts with shock and distress after the confrontation, holding a fan defensively and turning away—suggesting the immediate aftermath of physical combat.
A man in a red jacket is seen grabbing and physically engaging another person in a close-quarters struggle near a doorway.

The same two individuals (man in red jacket and another person) are shown in a continued physical confrontation, with the man in red holding the other person tightly while both display alarmed expressions.
A rapid motion blur shows one individual (likely Jackie Chan) swinging or being swung in a violent physical exchange, consistent with an ongoing fight sequence.
